ValidationRule.description: When a QA record is created it should be associated with either a case/interaction or reference field should be available.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Get_Help', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Join'), ISBLANK(Related_Case__c), ISBLANK(Reference__c), ISBLANK( Interaction__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please link the evaluation to the relevant Case or Interaction record. Otherwise, please populate the 'Reference' field.
